name: Hermey
subtitle: Your Hermes bots, on your phone
description: Native client for a self-hosted Hermes Agent. Every bot (Hermes profile) is reachable through one gateway; approvals, streaming replies and tool output appear in the conversation. Builds are unsigned and must be re-signed by your sideloading app.

apps.name: Hermey
apps.subtitle: Your Hermes bots, on your phone
apps.localizedDescription: Chats with every Hermes bot, streaming replies, tool cards, inline approvals and per-device pairing.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Added
- **Full screen in the shared computer, on both platforms.** The pane's own arrows hand the Mac's *window* to
  full screen (the green button's behaviour, falling back into its panel if you leave that way, `Esc` as the third
  exit) and drop the header, status bar and safe-area inset on the phone. Either platform keeps one floating bar
  with take-over / hand back, zoom −/+, the level, Fit and the exit. The picture zooms 1×–5× and pans — pinch about
  the pointer, two-finger scroll or ⌥-drag on the Mac, pinch and two-finger drag on the phone — clamped to the
  picture's edges, with take-over clicks still landing on the exact framebuffer pixel at any zoom.

### Fixed
- **The window follows the conversation the socket is naming.** A reply that arrived for the bot on screen but
  carrying a moved session id was counted in the sidebar preview and the unread badge and never drawn, so the
  thread sat still until the app was reopened or the chat was picked from All Sessions.
- **Take-over moves the lease in place** instead of rebuilding the viewer underneath you.

### Changed
- **Releases carry their notes.** The publish script reads this changelog for the version's section instead of
  falling back to "Build X (Y).", and updates the body of a release that already exists.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Hermes connects to your own Hermes host over your private network.
